riskClasses: schema/data migration or destructive data mutation
approver: PENDING — not yet reviewed by a human
why: Two of the six high-risk classes apply simultaneously. (1) billing/credits: this phase creates the credit ledger that Phase 2's spend gate will draw on, so a defect here mints money-equivalent value. The specific hazard identified and closed at PVL was accrual without a corresponding graph write — a credit for work never done. (2) schema/migration: two new Alembic revisions add three tables, a partial unique index, and one NOT NULL column on the existing high-traffic `sites` table. Both migrations are additive-only and were round-tripped on a disposable Postgres, but neither has been applied to any real environment.
productionExposure: NONE as shipped. `identity_coop_enabled` defaults False and `Site.contribution_enabled` defaults False with server_default='false', so the accrual hook is unreachable in every environment until BOTH are deliberately flipped. Neither migration has been live-applied. Enabling is an explicit operator action gated on legal review of the terms text (rollout order documented inline in config.py).
